name: Order me!
source:
Gabriel is one of the most successful pop stars in his country, Neo-Paradise: the idol of many teenagers. Yet, here is the thing: he is longing to go back to singing more operatic songs, considering he is a classical-trained countertenor.
What prevents him from stopping his career, you may ask? Seiji, his scene partner, with whom he is deeply in love (although he won’t admit it): he doesn’t want to abandon him.

With Valentine’s Day approaching, will Gabriel be able to confess all his feelings to him? And what will happen after Valentine’s Day?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230519074306/https://chimeriquement.itch.io/order-me]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
加布里埃尔是他的国家“新天堂”最成功的流行歌星之一：许多青少年的偶像。然而，事情是这样的：考虑到他是一位受过古典音乐训练的假声男高音，他渴望回去唱更多的歌剧歌曲。
你可能会问，是什么阻止他停止自己的职业生涯？诚司，他的场景搭档，他深深地爱着他（尽管他不会承认）：他不想抛弃他。

情人节即将来临，加百列能否向他坦白自己的全部感情呢？情人节之后会发生什么？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230519074306/https://chimeriquement.itch.io/order-me]Itch.io[/url]]
